one_line: Sultan of Bengal who fused law, Persian poetry and global diplomacy in the late 14th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, medium height, lean but dignified build with a poised bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm wheatish-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes with calm confidence, slight thoughtful furrow to the brows, default expression composed and reflective rather than stern.
appearance.hair: Short, dark brown hair, straight and neatly combed back under a soft, slightly tapered red velvet turban wrapped simply with a cream band and a small gold turban ornament at the front (no large plume).
appearance.costume: A long, full-sleeved, knee-length jama-style robe in rich deep indigo cotton with subtle gold floral block-print motifs, fastened diagonally across the chest with small brass buttons; over it a sleeveless, hip-length quilted waistcoat in muted crimson with fine gold edging; a wide leather belt dyed dark brown with a simple brass buckle and a narrow cloth sash in pale cream knotted at the left hip; loose straight trousers in soft cream cotton tucked neatly into mid-calf brown leather boots; around his shoulders a light, finely woven white cotton shawl with thin blue border, draped from left shoulder across the back; he wears modest gold stud earrings, a plain gold signet ring on his right hand, and a short string of dark prayer beads looped at his belt.
appearance.signature: A slender, slightly curved Indo-Persian sword (talwar) sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt while his left hand holds a rolled manuscript tied with a blue ribbon.

ref_desc: Ghiyasuddin Azam Shah is a wheatish oval-faced, short-bearded man in a deep indigo patterned jama, crimson quilted waistcoat, cream trousers, brown boots, red turban, with a talwar at his hip and a blue-tied manuscript, in indigo, crimson, cream, brown and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Ghiyasuddin Azam Shah: a mid-30s, lean, wheatish-brown Sultan with an oval face, sharp dark eyes, neat short beard and composed, thoughtful expression. His hair is short and dark brown, covered by a simple red velvet turban wrapped with a cream band and a small gold ornament at the front. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length deep indigo cotton jama robe decorated with subtle gold floral block-print motifs, fastened diagonally with small brass buttons, over which sits a sleeveless quilted waistcoat in muted crimson edged in fine gold trim. A wide dark brown leather belt with a brass buckle secures the waist, with a narrow pale cream cloth sash knotted at his left hip. His loose cream cotton trousers fall into mid-calf brown leather boots, and a light white cotton shawl with a thin blue border is draped from his left shoulder across his back. He has modest gold stud earrings, a plain gold signet ring on his right hand, and a short loop of dark prayer beads hanging from his belt. At his left hip is a slender, slightly curved talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt while his left hand holds a rolled manuscript tied with a blue ribbon. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, crimson red, cream white, warm brown and gold, shown consistently from front and side views with clear costume and weapon details.
